Title: MemorySmith.Agent — World Event Type Catalog (34 Events)
Content:
All event types are sealed records in Agent.Core/Events/WorldEvents.cs, inheriting from abstract record WorldEvent(DateTimeOffset Timestamp).

The wire protocol uses lowercase JSON event names. WebSocketBridge.ParseEvent routes by 'event' field. Events without a wire name are synthetic C# events created by AgentBackgroundService (not received from the Node.js adapter).

### Wire Notes
- **'move'** fires on every position change (high frequency); **'moveComplete'** fires at pathfinder goal arrival. Both produce `MoveEvent`.
- **'craftComplete'** (wire) → `CraftCompleteEvent` (C#) → AgentBackgroundService creates `ItemCraftedEvent` (synthetic). Not the same event.
- **'smeltComplete'** (wire) → `SmeltCompleteEvent` (C#) → AgentBackgroundService creates `ItemConsumedEvent` (synthetic) from ingredient deduction.
- **DamageTakenEvent**, **ItemCraftedEvent**, **ItemConsumedEvent** have no wire name — they are synthesized C#-side by AgentBackgroundService.
- **'blockNotFound'** is sent for both mine (no blocks found) and findReachableBlock (unreachable). C# must distinguish by context.
- **'entityObserved'** has a 3-second cooldown (ENTITY_SCAN_COOLDOWN_MS), emitted only when entities are present within 32 blocks.
- **'blockBelowChanged'** has a 1-second cooldown, emitted only when the block type changes.

## Event Routing in ProcessEventsAsync (AgentBackgroundService.cs ~line 400)

After projector apply, each event type routes to correlation completion:
- SpawnEvent → logs spawn position
- StatusEvent → CompleteCorrelatedActionByTool('GetStatus'/'Status')
- BlockMinedEvent → CompleteCorrelatedActionByTool('MineBlock')
- CraftCompleteEvent → CompleteCorrelatedActionByTool('CraftItem')
- SmeltCompleteEvent → CompleteCorrelatedActionByTool('SmeltItem')
- KickedEvent → cancel _connectionCts (force reconnect)
- ChatEvent → write to _chatChannel (offloaded to ChatConsumerAsync)
- FlatAreaFoundEvent (area >= 25) → CompleteCorrelatedActionByTool('FindFlatArea')
- FlatAreaFoundEvent (area < 25) → track zero-area scans, fallback after 2
- MoveEvent → CompleteCorrelatedActionByTool('MoveTo')
- WanderCompleteEvent → CompleteCorrelatedActionByTool('Wander')
- WanderFailedEvent → FailCorrelatedActionByTool('Wander')
- MineAbortedEvent → CompleteCorrelatedActionByTool('MineBlock') (terminal)
- StopCompleteEvent → log emergency stop acknowledgment
- ReachableBlockFoundEvent → CompleteCorrelatedActionByTool('FindReachableBlock')
- BlockPlacedEvent → CompleteCorrelatedActionByTool('PlaceBlock') + advance build checkpoint
- BlockPlaceSkippedEvent → CompleteCorrelatedActionByTool('PlaceBlock') (no checkpoint advance)
- ActionCompletedEvent → CompleteCorrelatedActionByTool(action name)
- ActionFailedEvent → FailCorrelatedActionByTool(action name)
- Default → TryRouteAsError (maps BlockNotFoundEvent/ErrorEvent to _gameErrors)

## StoreFacts Method

Records typed event properties as prefixed facts (e.g., event:Spawn:Health=20). Prefix uses GetEventKind(ev) which strips 'Event' suffix from type name. SourceFor: ErrorEvent → FactSource.Inferred, everything else → FactSource.Observed. StoreFacts handles all 34 event types with typed case branches for diagnostic fact storage.
